intervention.description: Tadpoles bathed in 250 uM MS222 for the first 24 h after tail amputation, then moved to 0.1x MMR.

notes: Only the share of tails with no regeneration is given in the text; the full/partial split of the rest is not reported (category bars are in figures/supplement not on disk). The 'none' count is converted from the percentage using the stated n; n_total is left null because the validator requires counts to sum to n_total and adding a full/partial split would invent data. Text: 45% of tails (n = 106 tadpoles) without regeneration; 45% of 106 = 47.7, rounded to 48.

adjudication.note: B set organism to planaria (wrong) and put the percent as the count; A's n-based count and xenopus kept.
